title: Rules from last week's corrections — Mon Nov 9, 2026

items.text: Interactive Pages must save for real
items.summary: CFO, 11/3. Your Card 6761 picks didn't save because the Page kept them only in the browser. Rule for every bot: any Page that takes your input saves it somewhere durable and gets a reload test before it reaches you. Goes in the fleet rules (TEMPLATE.md).

items.text: Research means a real multi-source pass
items.summary: Ideas, twice. 11/4: "don't be so quick and lazy... do the true research." 11/8: the no-website list came mostly from the Chamber directory, which skews toward businesses that already have sites. Rule: research asks get several independent sources before they're reported; for no-website hunts use Maps and review listings, social pages, booking apps and license or permit rolls, with chamber lists only as a side check. Goes in Ideas' and Researcher's job cards.

items.text: Print Hybrid has no vinyl cutter
items.summary: Rosey, 11/5. Never suggest cutting vinyl in-house. This is a shop fact, so it goes in shared memory every bot sees, not a job card.

items.text: Group chats: one correct answer is enough
items.summary: PrintHybrid Website, 11/6 in Coder Group. "Only one correct response is needed." Rule: if a teammate already answered your question correctly, the rest stay quiet. Goes in the fleet rules for every group chat.

items.text: Website-offer peers must match the product
items.summary: Rosey, 11/8. I showed you monthly design-and-host shops. You wanted companies doing what you do: rebuilding existing local-business sites and publicly promising fast loading plus AI and agent SEO. Rule goes in my memory and the Site Rebuild card for any competitor or peer search.

Rosey, six corrections 11/8 to 11/9 (same evening, so it repeated before any rule could land). Rule: real English words only, no coined blends; Group on the end reads as established; the words must signal AI, agents and tech moving forward, not generic corporate words like Horizon or Beacon; when you like a word, new ideas keep that exact word; and don't just re-stack Agent or AI onto the same few words. Goes in my memory and in Ideas' card.

items.text: LNB vs QuickBooks is not a risk
items.summary: CFO, today 7:56 AM. The roughly $146.9K gap between the bank and QuickBooks is bank activity the bookkeeper hasn't synced yet, not a books gap. Rule: CFO stops calling it a risk in memos and board numbers. Goes in CFO's job card.

Rosey, 11/4: "why don't you work on solving it yourself." That rule was already approved and applied on 10/12, so this is a repeat after a rule, not a new one. No new wording; I'm flagging it so you can see it slipped once.

The 10/26 list (12 cards) and the 11/2 list (13 cards) were never submitted, so none of those rules are applied yet. Biggest ones: Site Rebuild keeps the customer's look, Vault first for logins, after-hours deploys. 11/2 list: https://seankirk77.github.io/ck-eda0a596/4eb274e7a6bbfca2e85c90e7/?list=corrections-2026-11-02
items.rec: Open it when you have five minutes.

items.text: This week's one change: one Submit a week
items.summary: Four Monday lists in a row (two board, two corrections) have no Submit, so rules pile up unapplied. Proposal: starting next Monday, the corrections review rides as the last five cards on the board decisions list, so you have one list and one Submit a week. Alternative: keep them separate, and any card unanswered for two weeks closes as no change (bots keep it only in their own memory).
items.rec: Do it (merge into the board list).
